title: docs: clarify when skopeo operations require root
body:
## Summary
- Clarify in README and skopeo(1) that no subcommand always requires root
- Privilege needs depend on transport/parameters (e.g. root-owned `docker-daemon:` or system-wide `containers-storage:`)
Fixes #2489
## Test plan
- [ ] Read README intro for clarity
- [ ] `make docs` and check the DESCRIPTION note in `skopeo.1`
